hypotheses.title: Fundamental Book-to-Price Value Anomaly with Short-Term Delta Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Classic Fama-French Value anomaly: stocks where book value per share is near its 1-year historical high relative to market equity price are fundamentally underpriced. Coupling with short-term price delta reversion cushions temporary liquidity overshoots while maintaining low turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high book-to-price firms face systemic insolvency write-downs.

candidates.rationale: Book-to-Price Value Anomaly with Price Delta Reversion

hypotheses.title: Analyst Consensus Cash Flow Per Share Yield with Mean Reversion Overlay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow is resistant to aggressive accrual management. Equities where consensus forward cash flow per share trades at a historical premium relative to share price offer durable operational distribution capacity.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if consensus cash flows fail to materialize into reported cash from operations.

candidates.rationale: Analyst Consensus Cash Flow Yield & Price Reversion

hypotheses.title: Quarterly Sales-to-Price Revenue Yield Anomaly with Short-Term Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Top-line revenue is the hardest accounting metric to manipulate. Equities trading at deep discounts relative to their historical quarterly sales revenue deliver top-line insulation against margin compression, generating persistent cross-sectional outperformance.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if sales expansion is driven entirely by unprofitable margin dumping.

candidates.rationale: Reported Quarterly Sales-to-Price Yield & Price Reversion
